emily: Deploybot paused tonight's rollout (INC-2026-3344). Tagging release owners — can anyone take the release-note update and ops checklist?

deploybot: Rollout paused due to incident INC-2026-3344. Affected tag: v4.2.1. All stages blocked until manual resume.

sre-oncall: Initial triage: unexpected API gateway throttling in us-east-1 triggered canary failures. We're rolling back a config pushed earlier to throttling rules; ETA 30-60m.

omar: Proposal: pin traffic back to v4.2.0 and prepare rollback steps in release notes. If resume happens, start with canary=1% and 10m observation.

emily: I'll draft the release-note patch with the rollback CLI and a short customer line. @kevin can you sign off?

kevin: Happy to sign off. Make sure the rollback snippet is exact so support can run it without escalation. Also include the tentative resume timeline and monitoring thresholds.

sre-oncall: Before any resume, we'll apply these safeguards: `canary_percent=1`, `circuit_breaker=on`, `throttle_override=off`, `fallback=v4.2.0`. Abort/resume conditions: abort on 5xx > 0.6% sustained for 5m, resume only after 15m of error-rate < 0.2%.

deploybot: Applying pre-resume config now:
```
set canary_percent=1
set circuit_breaker=on
set throttle_override=off
enable fallback v4.2.0
pause_until 3577773000  # tentative resume
```
Results: canary_percent=1 check, circuit_breaker=on check, throttle_override=off check, fallback=v4.2.0 check.

emily: Release-note PR opened with rollback command: `infractl rollback --svc api --from v4.2.1 --to v4.2.0`. Customer blurb: "We're pausing the v4.2.1 rollout to investigate an API gateway throttling issue; we'll resume when metrics stabilise."

kevin: Reviewed and approved the PR. I'll merge once SRE gives green.

omar: I'll monitor and post a health update every 10m. Call for resume if green before tentative time, otherwise we defer to the 03:00 UTC maintenance window.

sre-oncall: Copy. Posting first update in 10m.

emily: Thanks all, keeping updates in this thread only.
